ai.seo_question: Why are those who pray warned of woe in Surah Al-Ma'un?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the hypocrisy of the Quraysh elite who maintained the outward form of Salah while neglecting its inner essence and social duties, such as caring for the orphan and feeding the poor. The warning of 'woe' underscores the principle that ritual acts devoid of sincerity (ikhlas) and practical compassion are spiritually void.
